youtube.description:
Uncle asked: "Do I really need to bathe before my operation?" 🛁
Dr Saathi said: Yes! Clean skin means less infection. 💚

What's the truth?
✅ Take a bath with soap the day before your operation or on the same day
✅ It reduces germs on your skin
✅ Don't shave the area yourself with a razor, it raises the risk of infection
✅ If hair must be removed, hospital staff will use clippers

No fear, just prepare!
